newsitem.title: DUBAI: Saudi launches agriculture marketing firm.
newsitem.headline: Saudi launches agriculture marketing firm.

text.p: Saudi Arabia on Sunday launched a company capitalised at $133 million to market agricultural products.

Minister of Agriculture and Water Resources Abdullah bin Abdul-Aziz bin Muammar said the Saudi Agriculture Marketing Company (SAMCO), with capital of 500 million riyals ($133 million) divided into 5 million shares, would market farm output inside the kingdom and abroad.
Speaking to a gathering of Saudi businessmen and farmers, he said the firm would be open to both government and private investment but the government's stake would be determined at a later date.
Muammar said the kingdom's total agricultural output in 1995 was valued at 31 billion riyals.
The kingdom produced 3.7 million tonnes of fruit and vegetables in 1995, he said.
Milk production reached 698,000 tonnes in 1995. Saudi Arabia produced 2.5 billion eggs in 1995, Muammar said.
